passages.p1: Part 6. Read the following passage and write the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the correct word or phrase that best fits each of the numbered blanks. People communicate in many ways. Some use words, while others use body language or facial expressions. Communication can be easy when people share the same language and culture. However, when they come from different backgrounds, misunderstandings can (26) ___________. For example, in some cultures, making direct eye contact is a sign of confidence, but in others, it might seem (27) ______. Similarly, some gestures that are friendly in one country may be rude in another. (28) ______, a thumbs-up sign means “good” in many places, but in some countries, it is considered impolite. To avoid confusion, it is important to learn about cultural differences. This can help people (29) ______ better relationships and communicate more effectively. After all, understanding and respect (30) ______ good communication.
passages.p2: Part 7. Read the following passage and write the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions. These days, many young people prefer online learning to traditional classrooms. With the internet, they can study from anywhere and at any time. Some students take online courses to improve their skills, while others use them to complete their degrees. However, online learning also has challenges. Without a teacher in the room, students must be more responsible for their learning. Some find it hard to stay motivated, and others miss interacting with classmates. Still, online learning is becoming more popular. Many universities and companies now offer online courses, and technology keeps improving. In the future, learning might be a mix of both online and classroom experiences.
